purpose: Descriptive capability taxonomy covering every frozen masterplan volume while preserving a distinct runtime-availability registry.

policy.volume_coverage_rule: Every masterplan volume appears exactly once in volume_mappings.
policy.naming_rule: Declared capability phrases normalize by Unicode-preserving lowercase plus whitespace collapse; concept IDs are stable FNV-1a identities over the normalized phrase.
policy.runtime_rule: Runtime availability is projected only from machine/ai_capabilities.json descriptors and their readiness/degraded semantics.
policy.trace_identity_rule: volume_mappings.trace_capability_ids identify corresponding declared-capability instance nodes in machine/master_traceability.json; normalized concepts do not replace those instance IDs.

readiness_requirements: canonical conversation ingress or explicitly stateless request
provider interaction protocol supports tool calls
at least one authorized read tool admitted
